title: The Fang of Abyss
summary: Ha-Jun battles the 40-foot Abyssal Void Dragon in the Colosseum of Necrothea. Dodging spatial erasure beams, he shatters the crystal prism and seizes the Fang of Abyss to turn the tide.

panels.shot: spatial breath beam tearing through arena wide shot
panels.action: The 10-meter-wide violet void beam disintegrates bone tiles, stone pillars, and air itself in a straight trench.
panels.prose_en: The 10-meter-wide violet void beam disintegrates bone tiles, stone pillars, and air itself in a straight trench.
panels.prose_hi: 10 meter chaudi baingani shunya kiran haddi ki tilon, patthar ke khambhon aur hawa ko ek sidhi khai mein vighatit kar deti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun executing supersonic evasive leap
panels.action: Ha-Jun catapults sideways into the air, the void beam deleting the afterimage of his silhouette.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh aag nahi hai... Yeh space ko delete kar raha hai! Touch bhi hua toh gayab!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun catapults sideways into the air, the void beam deleting the afterimage of his silhouette.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun bagal mein hawa mein udta hai, shunya kiran uske silhut ki baad ki chhavi ko hata deti hai.

panels.shot: trench where beam hit erased into nothingness
panels.action: Where the beam struck, there is no rubble—only a smooth, terrifying void gap looking into empty cosmos.
panels.prose_en: Where the beam struck, there is no rubble—only a smooth, terrifying void gap looking into empty cosmos.
panels.prose_hi: Jahan kiran takrai, vahan koi malba nahin hai - keval khali brahmand mein dekhne wali ek chikani, bhayanak shunya khai hai.

panels.shot: dragon sweeping massive spiked tail
panels.action: The Void Dragon whips its 30-foot spiked obsidian tail horizontally like a high-speed freight train.
panels.prose_en: The Void Dragon whips its 30-foot spiked obsidian tail horizontally like a high-speed freight train.
panels.prose_hi: Void dragon apni 30 foot ki nukili obsidian poonch ko ek uchch gati wali maalgadi ki tarah kshaitij roop se ghumata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun raising bone gauntlet to brace
panels.action: Ha-Jun interlocks his bone gauntlet plates, preparing for the devastating kinetic impact.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun interlocks his bone gauntlet plates, preparing for the devastating kinetic impact.
panels.prose_hi: Vinashakari gatij prabhav ke liye taiyari karte hue, Ha-Jun apni haddi ki gauntlet platon ko aapas mein jodta hai.

panels.shot: tail impact blasting ha-jun through spectator seats
panels.action: The massive tail strikes his bone shield; Ha-Jun is blasted 80 feet through stone spectator thrones.
panels.prose_en: The massive tail strikes his bone shield; Ha-Jun is blasted 80 feet through stone spectator thrones.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal poonch uski haddi ki dhal se takrati hai; Ha-Jun ko patthar ke darshak sinhasanon ke madhyam se 80 feet tak visphotit kiya gaya hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun sliding to stop in stone rubble
panels.action: Ha-Jun slides to a halt among broken thrones, coughing violet dust but with his bone gauntlet unbroken.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kinetic dispersal marrow... Sach mein impact ko ground kar diya.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slides to a halt among broken thrones, coughing violet dust but with his bone gauntlet unbroken.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun toote hue sinhasanon ke beech fisalkar ruk jata hai, baingani rang ki dhul kha raha hai, lekin uski haddi ka kavach toota hua nahin hai.

panels.shot: kuro diving at dragon eyes with shadow talons
panels.action: Kuro dives from the rafters, raking his sharpened shadow talons across the dragon's upper two eyes.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: BLIND HIM! HA-JUN, GO FOR THE PRISM!

panels.prose_en: Kuro dives from the rafters, raking his sharpened shadow talons across the dragon's upper two eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro chhat se gota lagata hai, aur dragon ki upari do aankhon par apni nukili chhaya ke panjon ko ghumata hai.

panels.shot: dragon roaring in pain, clawing at kuro
panels.action: The dragon thrashes its massive horned head, roaring as black blood leaks from its scratched eyes.
panels.prose_en: The dragon thrashes its massive horned head, roaring as black blood leaks from its scratched eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Dragon apne vishal seeng wale sir ko jor se pitata hai, aur uski kharonchi hui aankhon se kala khoon risne lagta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun vaulting out of rubble toward central pedestal
panels.action: Ha-Jun bounds across the broken stone tiers, rocketing straight toward the floating crystal prism.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun bounds across the broken stone tiers, rocketing straight toward the floating crystal prism.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun toote hue patthar ke staron ko paar karta hua sidhe tairte crystal prism ki or badhta hai.

panels.shot: dragon swinging front claw to crush pedestal
panels.action: Seeing Ha-Jun's target, the dragon brings its 10-foot razor-taloned foreleg down to crush the pedestal.
panels.prose_en: Seeing Ha-Jun's target, the dragon brings its 10-foot razor-taloned foreleg down to crush the pedestal.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke lakshya ko dekhakar, dragon kursi ko kuchalne ke liye apna 10 foot ka ustra-pankh wala agla pair neeche lata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun sliding between dragon talons
panels.action: Ha-Jun slides on his knees along the bone floor, slipping mere inches between the descending dragon claws.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slides on his knees along the bone floor, slipping mere inches between the descending dragon claws.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne ghutnon ke bal haddi ke farsh par fisalta hai, aur dragon ke neeche utarte panjon ke beech mahaj kuch inch hi fisalta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun reaching floating rhomboid prism
panels.action: From directly beneath the beast, Ha-Jun leaps up to the floating 3-foot crystal prism.
panels.prose_en: From directly beneath the beast, Ha-Jun leaps up to the floating 3-foot crystal prism.
panels.prose_hi: Sidhe janwar ke neeche se, Ha-Jun tairte hue 3 foot ke crystal prism tak chhalang lagata hai.

panels.shot: coating right fist in concentrated hellfire
panels.action: Ha-Jun channels the full fury of the Ashen Heart into his clenched right fist: violet-crimson pyre.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun channels the full fury of the Ashen Heart into his clenched right fist: violet-crimson pyre.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ation heart ke poore krodh ko apni band dahini mutthi mein dalta hai: bangni-lal rang ki chita.

panels.shot: punching the hyper-dimensional crystal prism
panels.action: Ha-Jun's flaming fist slams into the center of the void crystal with 50 tons of focused kinetic mana.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's flaming fist slams into the center of the void crystal with 50 tons of focused kinetic mana.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki dhadhakti mutthi 50 ton kendrit gatij man ke saath shunya crystal ke kendra mein takrati hai.

panels.shot: hyper-dimensional prism fracturing into diamonds
panels.action: The indestructible void crystal shatters into millions of glittering diamond shards.
panels.prose_en: The indestructible void crystal shatters into millions of glittering diamond shards.
panels.prose_hi: Avinashi shunya crystal lakhon chamakdar heere ke tukdon mein toot jata hai.

panels.shot: the fang of abyss spinning free in midair
panels.action: The 8-inch jagged curved void dagger spins slowly in midair, radiating absolute darkness.
panels.prose_en: The 8-inch jagged curved void dagger spins slowly in midair, radiating absolute darkness.
panels.prose_hi: 8 inch ka dantedar ghumavdar shunya khanjar madhya hawa mein dhire-dhire ghumta hai, jisse purna andhkar fail jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun fingers closing around the dagger hilt
panels.action: Ha-Jun's fingers wrap around the cold, textured void-matter hilt with an audible magnetic snap.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's fingers wrap around the cold, textured void-matter hilt with an audible magnetic snap.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki ungaliyan ek shravya chumbkiya snap ke saath thande, banavat wale shunya-padarth mooth ke charon or lapetati han.

panels.shot: spatial distortion ripples bursting from ha-jun hand
panels.action: A sphere of distorted, mirrored space ripples outward 100 meters around Ha-Jun, warping gravity.
panels.prose_en: A sphere of distorted, mirrored space ripples outward 100 meters around Ha-Jun, warping gravity.
panels.prose_hi: Vikrit, pratibimbit antriksh ka ek gola gurutvakarshan ko vikrit karte hue, Ha-Jun ke charon or 100 meter ki doori par bahar ki or tarangit hota hai.

panels.shot: system interface fanfare for relic claim
panels.action: Golden-and-violet gothic runes celebrate the bond.

dialogue.text:
[RELIC CLAIMED: THE FANG OF ABYSS (RARE)]
Rank: Rare Sovereign Class
Authority: Spatial Severance (Can slice through physical & magical barriers)
Synchronization: 42.0%.

panels.prose_en: Golden-and-violet gothic runes celebrate the bond.
panels.prose_hi: Sunahre aur baingani gothic roon bandhan ka jashn manate han.

panels.shot: ha-jun inspecting the void dagger
panels.action: Ha-Jun turns the dagger; the blade has no physical edge—it is a literal tear in the fabric of space.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh talwar nahi hai... Yeh reality mein ek chhed hai. Jo bhi chhua, woh cut ho jayega!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun turns the dagger; the blade has no physical edge—it is a literal tear in the fabric of space.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun khanjar ghumata hai; blade mein koi bhautik kinara nahin hai - yah antriksh ke kapde mein ek shabdik aansu hai.

panels.shot: dragon turning with furious remaining eyes
panels.action: The dragon recovers, its remaining two eyes burning with apocalyptic rage as it lunges with jaws open.
panels.prose_en: The dragon recovers, its remaining two eyes burning with apocalyptic rage as it lunges with jaws open.
panels.prose_hi: Dragon theek ho jata hai, jab wah khule jabde ke saath fusfusata hai to uski shesh do aankhen sarvanashakari krodh se jalne lagti han.

panels.shot: ha-jun executing a casual midair slice with the fang
panels.action: Ha-Jun doesn't swing hard; he simply draws a clean, two-foot vertical line in the empty air.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun doesn't swing hard; he simply draws a clean, two-foot vertical line in the empty air.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun jor se nahin jhulta; wah bus khali hawa mein ek saf, do foot ki khadi rekha khinchta hai.

panels.shot: line in empty air tearing open into a black spatial rift
panels.action: The thin line in the air tears open into a razor-thin rift of black space that expands instantly.
panels.prose_en: The thin line in the air tears open into a razor-thin rift of black space that expands instantly.
panels.prose_hi: Hawa mein maujood patli rekha kali jagah ki ek behad patli daraar mein khulti hai jo turant failti hai.

panels.shot: dragon lunging headfirst into the spatial rift
panels.action: The dragon's charging maw strikes the invisible spatial seam; its indestructible scales are cleaved like silk.
panels.prose_en: The dragon's charging maw strikes the invisible spatial seam; its indestructible scales are cleaved like silk.
panels.prose_hi: Dragon ka charging mav adrishya sthanik seem se takrata hai; iske avinashi tarazu resham ki tarah kate hue han.

panels.shot: dragon skull severed cleanly along the median line
panels.action: The 40-foot beast freezes mid-lunge as a clean black line cuts through its skull and neck.
panels.prose_en: The 40-foot beast freezes mid-lunge as a clean black line cuts through its skull and neck.
panels.prose_hi: 40 foot ka janwar beech mein hi jam jata hai kyonki ek saaf kali rekha uski khopdi aur gardan ko kaatati hai.

panels.shot: colossal dragon collapsing in two halves
panels.action: The colossal Void Dragon splits into two halves, crashing with thunderous finality onto the bone arena.
panels.prose_en: The colossal Void Dragon splits into two halves, crashing with thunderous finality onto the bone arena.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal shunya dragon do hisson mein vibhajit ho jata hai aur haddi ke maidan par gadgdahat ke saath durghatnagrast ho jata hai.

panels.shot: dragon body dissolving into glowing purple mist
panels.action: The monster's immense corpse dissolves into a sea of luminous purple mana mist that carpets the colosseum.
panels.prose_en: The monster's immense corpse dissolves into a sea of luminous purple mana mist that carpets the colosseum.
panels.prose_hi: Rakshs ki vishal laash chamakdar baingani maina dhundh ke samudra mein ghul jaati hai jo colosium ko kalin banati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun landing lightly with fang of abyss in hand
panels.action: Ha-Jun lands with effortless grace, flipping the void dagger into a reverse grip.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: The Fang of Abyss... It cuts through reality itself.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lands with effortless grace, flipping the void dagger into a reverse grip.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun sahaj anugrah ke saath utarta hai, khali khanjar ko ulti pakad mein ghumata hai.

panels.shot: something glowing inside the severed dragon skull
panels.action: In the center of the dissolving skull, a dark celestial orb the size of an eyeball pulses with starry light.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: That light... Eye of the Night is inside the beast!

panels.prose_en: In the center of the dissolving skull, a dark celestial orb the size of an eyeball pulses with starry light.
panels.prose_hi: Vightit khopdi ke kendra men, ek netragolak ke aakaar ka ek gehra akashiya gola taron ki roshni ke saath spandit hota hai.
